text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The... The winner is Tokai Teio...! Tokai 
Teio has conquered the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio, right here... Achieves a 
miraculous, comeback victory...!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Everyooooooooone!! Thank you sooo much for 
the suppooort!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...What an incredible, breathtaking view. 
Is this how you felt when you won the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I felt so clear and triumphant, like "I 
did it!", and I just wanted to laugh out 
loud—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm noooooot satisfied at all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I mean, when you think about it, you beat 
me to the punch when it comes to 
surpassing the "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Basically, with today, it's 1 win and 1 
loss! That means the match isn't over yet, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Then we really have to settle this!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...See you at the next race.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Because the wind is meant to keep blowing—
